title: CEO-Bench：智能体能否玩转长期游戏？
summary: CEO-Bench通过模拟运营初创公司500天的任务，评估语言模型智能体在长期、不确定、动态环境中的综合能力，包括信息获取、策略制定和多任务协调。最强模型（Claude Opus 4.8和GPT-5.5）也仅能勉强维持初始资金，无法稳定盈利。
summary_en: CEO-Bench evaluates language model agents on a 500-day startup simulation, testing long-horizon navigation, noisy information acquisition, adaptation, and multi-task orchestration. Top models barely break even, highlighting the gap in sustained adaptive intelligence.
